lines.label: Change
lines.note: Innate: Hwei's damaging abilities mark enemies hit for 4 seconds. Damaging them with a different ability consumes the mark to create an explosion beneath them, dealing 35–180|magic damage (+ 30% AP) bonus magic damage to enemies in the area after 0.85 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: Hwei enters a disastrous mood, gaining access to its abilities as well as Wash Brush}}. He will exit the mood upon casting any of them.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active - QQ: Hwei slings a fireball in the target direction that explodes upon colliding with the first enemy or reaching maximum range, dealing 60–180 (+ 60% AP) (+ 4–6% of target's maximum health) magic damage to all nearby enemies. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped at 250 against monsters.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active - QW: Hwei calls upon a lightning bolt to strike at the target location after , dealing 80–160 (+ 25% AP) magic damage to enemies within the area.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Against enemies that are immobilize or isolated from their allies, Severing Bolt deals 200–350% damage based on the . This bonus damage is capped at 300 against monsters.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Severing Bolt deals 50% damage to minions and non-epic monsters.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active - QE: Hwei marks a blazing path in the target direction. After 0.7 seconds, the path erupts into volcanic explosions every from the point of cast. Each explosion creates a shockwave that deals 20–100 (+ 30% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Each explosion also leaves a lava fissure in its wake. A fissure lasts for 2.5 seconds, dealing 50/10 to 250/10 (+ 62.5/10% AP) magic damage every 0.25 seconds to enemies within the area and slow them by 30%.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Molten Fissure's damage is reduced to 60% against minions and increased to 135% against monsters.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: Hwei enters a serene mood, gaining access to its abilities as well as Wash Brush}}. He will exit the mood upon casting any of them.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active - WQ: Hwei forms a current of water in the target direction, creating a path for 4–6 seconds that grants him and allied champions 20–30% (+ 2% per 100 AP) bonus movement speed and ghosting for 0.5 seconds, refreshing every 0.125 seconds while they remain in the area.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active - WW: Hwei summons a pool of water at the target location, creating a protective zone for 3 seconds that grants him and allied champions a shield for 45–85 (+ 30% AP) for 0.5 seconds while within the area. The shield refreshes and increases in strength by 45/12 to 85/12 (+ 30/12% AP) every over the duration while they remain in the area, up to a total maximum shield of 90–170 (+ 60% AP).

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Pool of Reflection's shield strength is reduced to 50% for allies.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active - WE: Hwei surrounds himself in swirling flares that empower his next 3 basic attacks or ability hits within 9 seconds to each deal 25–65 (+ 20% AP) bonus magic damage and restore 135/3 to 195/3 mana.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Stirring Lights' bonus damage is reduced to 50% against minions or monsters if applied by his area of effect abilities.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: Hwei enters a tumultuous mood, gaining access to its abilities as well as Wash Brush}}. He will exit the mood upon casting any of them.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active - EQ: Hwei launches a terrifying grin in the target direction that deals 60–180 (+ 55% AP) magic damage to the first enemy hit and fear them for 1 second, during which they are slow by 60–99%.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active - EW: Hwei tosses an eyeball to the target location. Upon arrival, it expands into a dark gaze for 1.35 to 3 seconds based on cast distance, granting sight in a larger . After 0.7 seconds of being placed, the eye locks onto the nearest visible enemy champion, launching itself at the target after 0.35 seconds and colliding with the first enemy hit to deal 60–180 (+ 55% AP) magic damage, true sight them for 2.5 seconds, and root them for 1.2–2 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active - EE: Hwei conjures a jaw at the target location that snaps after , dealing 60–180 (+ 55% AP) magic damage to enemies in the area and slow them by 40–70%, decaying over 1.25 seconds. Enemies that are not standing at the center when the jaw snaps are airborne there.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active - QR, WR, ER: Hwei exits his current mood without incurring its ability cost or cooldown.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Wash Brush can only be cast if Hwei has entered a mood.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: Hwei launches a globule of pure despair in the target direction that collides with the first enemy champion hit, afflicting them with an aura that grows over 3 seconds, true sight the target, and grants sight within its radius. Enemies within are both dealt 10/4 to 30/4 (3 ranks) (+ 5/4% AP) magic damage and applied a stack of Despair every 0.25 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Despair: For each stack, the target is slow by 10% for 0.25 seconds, stacking up to 12 times.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: At the end of the duration or when the target dies, the aura explodes to deal 200–400 (3 ranks) (+ 80% AP) magic damage to enemies within and remove all Despair stacks from affected enemies.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Spiraling Despair can only be cast if Hwei has not entered a mood.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Cast Time: 0.25 seconds, Range: er , Effect Radius: cr , Width: er , Speed: 1400.

systems.name: Arena
systems.tldr: Gates; Hex-gates have been added to each of the 4 battle arenas, which function the same as those on the map on Summoner's Rift. Champions on either team can interact with these gates to dash to the other side of them…
systems.gameplayImpact: Arena was adjusted in mixed directions. Net power depends on playstyle — read the numbers before assuming a free buff or hard nerf.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Hex-gates have been added to each of the 4 battle arenas, which function the same as those on the map on Summoner's Rift. Champions on either team can interact with these gates to dash to the other side of them. Gates have a 7-second cooldown after being activated.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: When a champion on either team takes fatal damage for the first time each round, they enter a downed state where they are essentially dead. After 11-8 seconds (based on round number) of being downed, their ally can stand near where they entered the state for 3 seconds to afterwards revive them, heal them for 150–1425 and causing them to become untargetable, invulnerable, and unable to attack or cast spells for 0.75 seconds. They will also gain 30% damage reduction, 75% bonus movement speed, and 50% Tenacity for 3 seconds, decaying after 0.75 seconds over the remaining duration.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: The amount of time required for the revive to occur is cumulative; leaving the downed area will not reset the timer.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: The ally must not be under a resurrection effect in order to perform the revive.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Revive duration is reduced based on the ally's heal and shield power as well as their missing health.

systems.name: Gameplay
systems.tldr: Gates; Hex-gates have been added to each of the 4 battle arenas, which function the same as those on the map on Summoner's Rift. Champions on either team can interact with these gates to dash to the other side of them…
systems.gameplayImpact: Gameplay was adjusted in mixed directions. Net power depends on playstyle — read the numbers before assuming a free buff or hard nerf.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Hex-gates have been added to each of the 4 battle arenas, which function the same as those on the map on Summoner's Rift. Champions on either team can interact with these gates to dash to the other side of them. Gates have a 7-second cooldown after being activated.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: When a champion on either team takes fatal damage for the first time each round, they enter a downed state where they are essentially dead. After 11-8 seconds (based on round number) of being downed, their ally can stand near where they entered the state for 3 seconds to afterwards revive them, heal them for 150–1425 and causing them to become untargetable, invulnerable, and unable to attack or cast spells for 0.75 seconds. They will also gain 30% damage reduction, 75% bonus movement speed, and 50% Tenacity for 3 seconds, decaying after 0.75 seconds over the remaining duration.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: The amount of time required for the revive to occur is cumulative; leaving the downed area will not reset the timer.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: The ally must not be under a resurrection effect in order to perform the revive.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Revive duration is reduced based on the ally's heal and shield power as well as their missing health.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: The cameos for the following champions have been removed: , , , , , , and .

lines.label: Change
lines.note: The following cameos have been added:

lines.label: Change
lines.note: At the start of the combat round, breaks the chains to replace each champion's non- summoner spell with a random ultimate ability. Once the hijacked ability is cast, the spell in the slot is reverted back to the original one.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: roams around the battlefield to provide assistance. He periodically casts his Dark Passage}} to the champion furthest from him which also grants the nearest champion with the lowest health a continuous shield. Any champion on either team can interact with the lantern on the ground to dash to Thresh's location.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: If one of a team's champions is caught and downed in the Ring of Fire, Thresh will move to that player's location and throw his lantern towards their ally. Additionally, if one team outnumbers the other in alive members, he will always throw his lantern to the disadvantaged team.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Stats: 300 ability power, 20 ability haste, 50 armor.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Unique Active - Stasis: Put yourself in stasis (buff) for 2.5 seconds, rendering you untargetable and invulnerable for the duration but also unable to move, declare basic attacks, cast abilities, use summoner spells, or activate items.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Stats: 25 ability haste, 60 ability power, 15% heal and shield power.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Unique Active - Promise: Make a Promise to the target allied champion, forming a tether between you and them. Champions can only be promised to by one Wordless Promise at a time.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Unique Passive - Promise: While your Promised ally is to you, gain ability power equal to 20% of Promised ally's AP, and grant your Promised ally ability haste equal to 20% of your ability haste.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: No more than two champions can now possess the same augment.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: The following augments have been added:

lines.label: Change
lines.note: ADAPt, All For You, Angel of Retribution, Big Brain, Blood Brother, Bread And Butter, Bread And Cheese, Bread And Jam, Center of the Universe, Chain Lightning, Clothesline, Critical Healing, Dark Blessing, Deathtouch, Dematerialize, Desecrator, Don't Chase, Doomsayer, Draw Your Sword, EscAPADe, Fey Magic, Flashbang, Flashy, Fully Automated, Giant Slayer, Goredrink, Heavy Hitter, Hold Very Still, Holy Fire, Homeguard, Impassable, It's Killing Time, Laser Eyes, Magic Missile, Marksmage, Minionmancer, Mirror Image, Nesting Doll, Oathsworn, Orbital Laser, Parasitic Relationship, Plaguebearer, Quest: Steel Your Heart, Quest: Urf's Champion, Quest: Wooglet's Witchcap, Raid Boss, Restart, Scopier Weapons, Scopiest Weapons, Self Destruct, Serve Beyond Death, Skilled Sniper, Slap Around, Snowball Fight!, Spellwake, Spin To Win, Stackosaurus Rex, Summoner's Roulette, Twice Thrice, Ultimate Unstoppable.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: The following augments have been removed:

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Buckle Up, Evocation, Midnight Express, Windspeaker's Blessing, Zhonya's Epiphany.

lines.label: Maximum party size
lines.note: Maximum party size increased to 4 players from 2.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: When queuing with 3 players the party will be given the option to select who will be matched with a random player.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Players with an 8,100 rating or higher can now queue with only 1 other player, and players must be within 1,000 rating of one another to queue together.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Previously, players with a Gladiator rating could only queue with other Gladiator rated players.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: A full party of 8 players can queue together for an unrated game. There are no rating restrictions in private matches.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Arena ratings from the initial launch have been reset, and all players will begin in Wood tier with a 500 rating.

lines.label: Gold tier rating
lines.note: Gold tier rating increased to 3300 from 3200.

lines.label: Gladiator tier rating
lines.note: Gladiator tier rating increased to 4000 from 3800.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Challenges for the Arena mode in particular have been added:

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Cream of the Crop: Deal the most damage to champions in the game.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Dancing Shoes: Dodge 5 skillshots (ranged untargeted abilities) within 8 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: The Wall: Take 10,000 pre-mitigation damage from champions in a single fight without dying.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Outplaying the Odds: Get kills while more enemy champions than friendly ones are nearby.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: I've Got You!: Save an ally who would have otherwise taken lethal damage with a heal or shield.
